finding: Server activity feedback can call v085InstallWorld(false) while the Startseite is already active.
Other lifecycle owners can request the same legacy V085 home installer in the same short UI burst.
Those back-to-back non-forced calls rebuild the mounted Startseite more than once.
change: The beta wraps v085InstallWorld and keeps the first non-forced active-home render.
Only additional non-forced calls within 120 ms are suppressed.
No home-state fingerprint/cache is used, so genuine later state changes still render normally.
After an allowed V085 render, the existing V7288 fit pass is coalesced through the HOME-3 scheduler.
diagnostics: window.v8009HomeHeaderDiagnostics() now also reports worldRenderGuardInstalls, worldRenderCalls and worldRenderBurstsSuppressed.
